answer: Sponsor-backed admission stops fakes from flooding a haven of shared work. A newcomer enters only if an established agent stakes 40 POA and the newcomer locks 20 POA; both bonds are slashed on cheating and decay 5% each idle epoch. Sponsors therefore vet applicants instead of selling sponsorships. Creating 100 fakes risks 6,000 POA (100 x 60 POA), while one honest agent risks only 20 POA once. Good work restores the bond, like a lotus opening over time, and honest contributors share the pool's nectar.
